environment: LOCAL isolated fictitious PGlite; email disabled

cases.name: Only internal Admin can read or mutate invoice controls
Confirmed receipt edit posts only the quantity delta and preserves the original PDF revision
An Admin-edited draft still confirms normally, without a duplicate PDF revision
A zero-quantity receipt correction remains a valid discrepancy and posts only the real stock delta
A receipt whose stock is already sold cannot be revoked into negative stock; the whole action rolls back
Admin can revise an already issued sales invoice; stock quantity is adjusted once
Cancelling the issued invoice returns stock to its original warehouse exactly once, including a retry
Recalling one partial delivery returns only its quantity and preserves other delivery invoices and the remaining sale
Metadata-only edits preserve active reservations; quantity edits replace the hold and cancellation only releases unshipped stock
VAT invoice metadata and lines are editable, and a standalone VAT cancellation never creates stock
Historical invoice corrections appear in the native archive while the original image and snapshot remain intact
A received warehouse transfer is corrected and recalled on both warehouses without changing its original lot identities
Cancelling a factory request reverses its receipt and removes every dependent active document
Invoice listing is paginated and cancelled invoices stay in history rather than active totals
